title.en: Sand AI MAGI-2 (magi-2) Multimodal Video Model Available
title.zh: Sand AI MAGI-2（magi-2）多模态视频模型上线

summary.en: Sand AI MAGI-2 (magi-2) is now live on POST /v1/video/generations with native 1080p 25fps audio-video synthesis, 4–30s durations, and text, first-frame, first-last-frame, and multimodal reference modes.
summary.zh: Sand AI MAGI-2（magi-2）现已上线 POST /v1/video/generations，支持原生 1080p 25fps 同步音画输出、4 至 30 秒时长，以及文生视频、首帧、首尾帧与多模态参考生视频。

body.en:
## MAGI-2

**Sand AI MAGI-2 (`magi-2`)** is now available on OmniMux via `POST /v1/video/generations`.

### New model

- **Model ID:** `magi-2`
- **API:** `POST /v1/video/generations` and `GET /v1/video/generations/{task_id}`
- **Highlights:** Native 1080p 25fps video with synchronized audio at no extra charge, integer 4–30s durations, 6 aspect ratios (`16:9`, `9:16`, `1:1`, `4:3`, `3:4`, `21:9`), and `text_to_video`, `first_frame`, `first_last_frame`, and `video_multi_ref` (up to 10 images, 5 videos, and 5 audio references).
body.zh:
## MAGI-2

**Sand AI MAGI-2（`magi-2`）** 现已正式上线 OmniMux `POST /v1/video/generations`。

### 新模型特性

- **模型标识：** `magi-2`
- **接口路径：** `POST /v1/video/generations` 与 `GET /v1/video/generations/{task_id}`
- **核心能力：** 原生 1080p 25fps 同步音画输出（含音频不加价），支持 4 至 30 秒整数时长、6 种画面比例（`16:9`、`9:16`、`1:1`、`4:3`、`3:4`、`21:9`），覆盖文生视频、首帧、首尾帧及多模态参考（最多 10 张参考图、5 段参考视频与 5 段参考音频）。
